title: Fake Teacher DM
scenario: An account using your teacher’s photo asks you to buy gift cards for a class project.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Report/block it and do not share private details.
answers.D: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.

explanation: Fake Teacher DM: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Teachers do not ask students for gift-card purchases by DM.
